'''Melari Ruxon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. A member of the [[New Jedi Order]], she was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. She and another apprentice, [[Reeqo Swen]], assisted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her husband [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in the detainment of the [[Force psychosis|insane]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] and [[Bazel Warv]]. Shortly after, however, Ruxon and Swen decided to resign from the Order, as they were unhappy with the way [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] was beginning to take control of the Jedi.
